lambda.description: Lambda handlers in lambda/ — API Gateway, event-driven, or internal worker
queries: Lambda handler standards by invocation type API Gateway event-driven internal worker
Pydantic request validation requirements for Lambda handlers
Lambda error handling retry semantics and partial batch failure
structured logging and container-scope client initialization
SSM SecureString parameter access at module init

terraform.description: Infrastructure in terraform/ — including secondary-region mirrors
queries: Terraform module versioning and pinning standards
resource naming conventions and environment parameterization
least-privilege IAM policy patterns for Lambda execution roles
active-passive multi-region HA primary and secondary parity requirements
CloudWatch log retention and Lambda event source mapping configuration
Python testing standards structure and framework
mocking discipline for boto3 paginators and DynamoDB query pagination
test timeout and unbounded loop prevention in unit tests
test coverage gates for new code

ui.description: React frontend and Express proxy in ui/
queries: React component structure and state management standards
vitest mocking conventions for API modules and component props
frontend API client and error surface conventions

docs.description: ADRs and customer-facing documentation in docs/
queries: ADR authoring format and when a decision warrants an ADR
documentation-driven decisions over hardcoded platform logic

notes.haParity: Any chunk touching a primary-region Terraform resource MUST include the mirrored terraform/*-secondary.tf change and run make check-ha-parity. Divergence is invisible until failover.
notes.threeSurface: A chunk that ships a user-visible feature must update docs/features.md, ../marketing-for-outcomeops/outcomeops-feature-list.md, and Confluence page 57835580 in the same session.
notes.preCommit: make test-unit, make test-ui (if ui/ touched), make fmt + make validate-tf (if .tf touched), make audit.
notes.planQueue: plan-<name>/ dirs are user-created queue slots. Claude does not create them; it promotes them into plan/ when the active plan ships.
